waves.name: Integrated Base Gate
waves.exit: new worktree is clean and conflict files are final integrated versions
waves.rollback: do not start implementation; do not modify or revert another worktree or branch

waves.name: Return Resolver, State, Lifecycle
waves.exit: validated step return, exact CTA strings, new-session-before-dispatch, zero dispatch on session failure, accepted/failed/unknown classification, and Kakao union pass
waves.rollback: git revert <wave-1-sha>; do not revert DB rows or other workstream commits

waves.name: Localized Artifact Authority
waves.exit: editor ownership, source binding, provenance, human review, stale detection, and 12-language completeness pass inside existing workpack JSON boundary
waves.rollback: git revert <wave-2-sha>; create no schema or migration

waves.name: Share IA And Route Owners
waves.exit: zero worker mutation from Share, owner next routes, target to channel to localized preview to one CTA, no chip wall, and no nested scroll pass
waves.rollback: git revert <wave-3-sha>; preserve /workers roster and existing storage and dispatch APIs

waves.name: Real Browser Gate
commands: npm.cmd test -- tests/workspace-pages.test.ts tests/workflow-share-client.test.ts tests/workflow-share-panel-behavior.test.ts tests/workspace-workers.test.ts tests/foreign-worker-languages.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
waves.exit: 52 Chromium cases, request order and payload, return routing, task distance, 200 percent zoom, and Vietnamese gates pass
waves.rollback: git revert <wave-4-sha>; no real provider or DB mutation rollback exists
